newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN OVERNIGHT RATES CRASH ON SURPLUS FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN OVERNIGHT RATES CRASH ON SURPLUS FUNDS.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates crashed on Tuesday on surplus funds, dealers said.
In the morning trades were done at 15 percent but rates later rose to 16.50, before dropping to 10 percent when the market closed with excess liquidity, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

He said Wednesday's trend would depend on the impact of the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's weekly open market operation (OMO) against an inflow of about 3.8 billion rupees due to maturity of a previous OMO, he said.
